title_zh: 不把未回复当拒绝并约定简短询问

scenario.label_zh: 兄弟姐妹探访未回复的理解
scenario.goal_zh: 承认未能确认探访的遗憾，不把沉默解读为拒绝，并决定发一条不催促的询问信息

context_zh: 朋友讨论一位成年家人迟迟未回复探访安排的情况。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Robin
sentences.text: Alex is my only sibling, and I really wanted to visit this weekend. There is still no reply.

sentences.speaker: Jae
sentences.text: It is a shame you cannot make a plan yet. How long has it been?

sentences.speaker: Robin
sentences.text: Two days. I keep reading the silence as a sign that Alex does not want me there.

sentences.speaker: Jae
sentences.text: It could mean many things. Have you sent a simple question about whether this weekend works?

sentences.speaker: Robin
sentences.text: Not really. My message was a long list of possible plans.

sentences.speaker: Jae
sentences.text: You could ask once, without asking for an immediate answer, and leave the weekend open for now.

sentences.speaker: Robin
sentences.text: I'll do that: one short message asking whether a visit would work, and no more planning until I hear back.
